messages:
samira: Procurement question — we're evaluating Reconly (invoice-recon) for automating usage->invoice matching. Top priorities: high match rate for token/usage lines, SSO+SCIM, API + CSV ingestion, manual overrides & audit trail. Anyone with hands-on? @ravi @noah
noah: We piloted Reconly for a week in Q3 2025 for cloud spend. Match rate ~92% out of the box; fell to ~86% with nested line-items (usage + credits). Pricing: per-connector + per-invoice banding. See their public page: https://reconly.example/pricing
ravi: We tried their S3 ingestion pipeline. Needed a small mapping layer for tokenized usage vs line-item SKUs. Support provided a CLI helper but their support SLAs were slow (multi-day).
samira: Do they support scheduled reconciliations and manual adjudication UI? Need to annotate mismatches and export an immutable audit trail for audits.
noah: Scheduled jobs: yes. Manual adjudication: UI exists, but export options were CSV-only. No native BigQuery sink in the plan we tested.
ravi: For context, compare Reconly vs MatchMate. MatchMate is more flexible (webhooks, BigQuery sink) but is more infra-heavy and will need engineering to maintain. Reconly is lower ops but more black-box and connector-costly.
samira: Can someone sketch a quick TCO for 50k invoices/year, ~5 vendor feeds, 2 connectors each? Also need their SLA on invoice dispute turnaround (<48h ideally).
noah: I'll ask the AE for a firm enterprise quote and SLA. Can you draft a short Q-list to send? I'll include usage samples.
samira: Draft Q-list: 1) Sample match rate on LLM usage exports (we'll provide sample CSV/JSON) 2) Throughput / latency for a recon job processing 10k invoices 3) SSO/SCIM + RBAC support details 4) Retention policy & immutable audit logs 5) Connector limits / concurrency / parallelism 6) Export sinks (BigQuery, Redshift, S3) 7) Trial terms & data residency 8) Support SLA for disputes (target <48h)
ravi: Add: pricing model details (per-invoice vs per-row vs flat band) and whether they normalize billing units (tokens, embeddings, inference-seconds). Also ask what data they store and for how long (PII concerns).
noah: 👍 I'll combine this and ping Reconly AE. Would like the sample usage file by EOD so we can get a test match rate asap.
samira: Thanks — looping in finance-ops for compliance/questions. @procure-bot please create a vendor-ticket and track the quote when it arrives.
procure-bot: created ticket PV-2026-089 for Reconly evaluation and added samira, noah, ravi as watchers.
